findings.detail: R11 real cycles mutate only real bounded micro-target code inside isolated git clones under JARVIS_R11_TEMP.  No live daemon, database, vault, protected main, or owner project is touched; live guards record protected_state_unchanged=True.
findings.title: Real proving candidates are isolated fixture code changes

findings.detail: Each candidate is verified by python -m jarvis_foundry.evolution_live.verifier in a fresh temp clone; the engine refuses any verifier identity that matches the candidate, and the G04 gate re-runs the full reproduction subprocess.
findings.title: Independent verification is a fresh subprocess

findings.detail: Final candidate risk is the max of the declared class and classify_risk(surfaces); unknown surfaces fail closed to R3. No R11 code edits the V6 classifier.
findings.title: Risk classifier reused read-only from V6 evolution records

findings.detail: R11-G01..G06 reproduce the required evidence, but the final builder_status stays NOT_TESTED until a fresh independent verifier reproduces every criterion from the frozen package.
findings.title: Builder status remains NOT_TESTED until fresh independent adjudication

findings.detail: R11_PROGRESS_*.json are incremental working artifacts; evidence_bytes() and the manifest exclude them so the closed package matches the on-disk payload byte-for-byte.
findings.title: Progress checkpoints excluded from closure evidence

findings.detail: The live-guard comparison bracketing the full repository suite observed the protected process command set change from 4 to 2 (unrelated live supervisor processes stopping); r11_attributable_mutation was False and protected files, main, tasks, and vault were unchanged.  A quiet-window before/after/compare after all R11 work recorded protected_state_unchanged=True; the full-window captures are preserved as R11_LIVE_GUARD_FULLWINDOW_*.
findings.title: External supervisor process drift during the long full-suite window
